summary: House: 118–128 BPM four-on-the-floor, off-beat hats, minor-7th stabs or organ chords, a bouncing bass
body: Drums: kick on every beat, clap or snare on 2 and 4, open hat on every off-beat, 16th shakers or hats on top.
Harmony: one- or two-chord loops of minor 7ths and 9ths, played as short stabs on the off-beats (organ, piano, pad).
Bass: short notes on the off-beats or a syncopated riff around the root; ducked by the kick (sidechain pump).
Form: 8- and 16-bar phrases; builds by filtering parts in and out, drops by removing the kick for a bar or four.

Apply: pattern/four-on-the-floor on the drums, then pattern/prog-house-characteristic-2 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 118–128 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
